verdict: READY FOR CONTROLLED BETA WITH CONDITIONS
strongestAreas: Deterministic release, grading-cap, authorization, question-bank, session, Quorum, and sanitized-artifact regression coverage.
Responsive behavior across ten tested widths and Lighthouse accessibility scores of 100.
Truthful student-centered technical SEO with deterministic regression protection.
Existing rollback, GitHub Pages deployment, Worker versioning, and read-only production inventory discipline.
weakestAreas: No completed live, blind, non-credit Gemini legal-accuracy benchmark.
No authorized remote staging credentials for the two staging integration scripts.
No isolated two-user synthetic persona set for cross-user mutation journeys in this cycle.
Mobile performance remains only moderate and is sensitive to the large single-page application and external-font timing.
launchConditions: Keep the beta invitation-only and monitor Worker errors, provider quota, grading latency, and support volume daily.
Do not expand beyond the provisional limits until the 24-sample blind benchmark has real provider results.
Pause grading expansion on any fabricated authority, privacy defect, cross-user isolation failure, or repeated false-high score.
Retain manual primary-source verification language for all model answers.

totalInvitedBetaUsers.basis: Inference from seven current accounts, static regression coverage, and unmeasured provider quota.
totalInvitedBetaUsers.monitoringTrigger: More than 10 daily active users or support response time above one business day.
totalInvitedBetaUsers.pauseTrigger: Any critical security/legal defect or two unresolved high-severity incidents.

expectedDailyActiveUsers.basis: Conservative support and observability envelope; not a measured platform ceiling.
expectedDailyActiveUsers.monitoringTrigger: Daily grading failures above 2% or p95 grading latency above 30 seconds.
expectedDailyActiveUsers.pauseTrigger: Provider capacity errors persist for 15 minutes.

maximumConcurrentSignedInUsers.basis: No isolated concurrency test has established a higher safe operational limit.
maximumConcurrentSignedInUsers.monitoringTrigger: Authentication, autosave, or database errors during overlapping sessions.
maximumConcurrentSignedInUsers.pauseTrigger: Any cross-user data exposure or duplicate submission.

maximumConcurrentExaminationSessions.basis: Session and timer contracts pass, but live multi-session recovery was not load-tested this cycle.
maximumConcurrentExaminationSessions.monitoringTrigger: Autosave success below 99.5% or timer drift above 5 seconds.
maximumConcurrentExaminationSessions.pauseTrigger: Any lost draft or unrecoverable active attempt.

maximumSimultaneousGeminiGradingRequests.basis: Provider quota and safe non-credit concurrency remain unknown.

dailyGradedAnswerCapPerUser.basis: Matches the established guest-preview cap and limits legal/reliability exposure during validation.
dailyGradedAnswerCapPerUser.monitoringTrigger: Disputes, corrections, or false-high reports exceed one per 20 grades.
dailyGradedAnswerCapPerUser.pauseTrigger: Any verified fabricated authority or materially unsafe false-high.

totalDailyGeminiGradingCap.basis: Operational inference, not measured capacity; preserves a small reviewable daily corpus.
totalDailyGeminiGradingCap.monitoringTrigger: At 15 daily grades, review provider errors, latency, and correction reports before continuing.
totalDailyGeminiGradingCap.pauseTrigger: Any quota warning or unresolved grading incident.
